_comment: ConversationTurn placement: one in-flight task per turn. Persistence: immutable fixture/turn metadata and scoped hashes only. Concurrency: turn epoch compare-and-cancel.

_ignores.route: routing requires a valid ephemeral transcript
_ignores.advanceEpoch: a receiving turn has no prior epoch to supersede
_ignores.finish: the turn has no rendered outcome yet

_ignores.transcribe: one transcript decision is bound to the turn
_ignores.advanceEpoch: the routed transcript has not yet created slow work
_ignores.finish: a response has not been rendered

_ignores.transcribe: the turn transcript is immutable after routing
_ignores.finish: slow work must terminalize before rendering

_ignores.transcribe: confirmation is bound to the original transcript and action hash
_ignores.awaitConfirmation: the turn is already waiting for one exact confirmation
_ignores.finish: confirmation must resolve before a normal response

_ignores.transcribe: processing-only input is no longer accepted
_ignores.advanceEpoch: terminal rendering is canceled by the renderer priority rule
_ignores.awaitConfirmation: no confirmation is pending in this state
